ὑάκινθος.shortDefinition: a blue (yarn/cloth), hyacinth; fig. a jacinth (gem)

ὑβρίζω.shortDefinition: to insult, mistreat, outrage; fig. to be insolent

ὕβρις.shortDefinition: a hubris, insolence; fig. an insult, injury, damage

ὑγιάζω.shortDefinition: to make healthy, restore to health

ὑγρός.shortDefinition: to be moist, wet; fig. to be green, sappy

ὑδρωπικός.shortDefinition: to be dropsical, swollen with fluid

ὑετίζω.shortDefinition: to bring rain, cause to rain

υἱοθεσία.shortDefinition: an adoption (as son); lit. a placing as a son

ὕλη.shortDefinition: a wood (forest or fuel); fig. a matter, material

ὑλώδης.shortDefinition: to be woody, bushy; fig. to be flush, well-stocked

ὑμνητός.shortDefinition: to be hymned, worthy of praise

ὑπάγω.shortDefinition: to lead around, go by/around; fig. to depart, go away

ὕπαιθρος.shortDefinition: to be under the sky, in the open air

ὕπανδρος.shortDefinition: to be married, under a husband

ὕπαρξις.shortDefinition: a subsistence; fig. a possession(s), goods, wealth

ὕπατος.shortDefinition: to be supreme, highest; fig. to be a consul

ὑπεναντίος.shortDefinition: to be opposing, adverse; fig. to be an adversary

ὑπεξαιρέω.shortDefinition: to remove secretly, take away (from under)

ὑπεραινετός.shortDefinition: to be praiseworthy above all, super-praiseworthy

ὑπεραίρω.shortDefinition: to rise above, surpass; refl. to exalt oneself, be overbearing

ὑπέρακμος.shortDefinition: to be past one’s prime, past the bloom of youth

ὑπεράλλομαι.shortDefinition: to rise to prominence; lit. to leap over

ὑπεράνωθεν.shortDefinition: from high above, from far above

ὑπερασπίζω.shortDefinition: to hold a shield over, protect

ὑπεραυξάνω.shortDefinition: to grow exceedingly, increase beyond measure

ὑπερβαίνω.shortDefinition: to step over, go beyond; fig. to transgress, pass over

ὑπερβάλλω.shortDefinition: to exceed, surpass; lit. to throw beyond

ὑπερβολή.shortDefinition: a surpassing (greatness), excess; lit. a throwing beyond

ὑπερεντυγχάνω.shortDefinition: to intercede on behalf of, plead for

ὑπερέχω.shortDefinition: to stand out above, excel; fig. to be superior, surpass

ὑπερηφανεύω.shortDefinition: to act arrogantly, put on airs

ὑπέρκειμαι.shortDefinition: to take precedence (over), exceed; lit. to lie above

ὑπερμαχέω.shortDefinition: to fight on behalf of, defend

ὑπέρμαχος.shortDefinition: to be fighting on behalf of, defending

ὑπέρογκος.shortDefinition: to be overswollen, enormous; fig. to be pompous, too difficult

ὑπεροράω.shortDefinition: to take no notice of, overlook; fig. to disdain

ὑπεροχή.shortDefinition: a superiority, preeminence; fig. an authority, excellence

ὑπερυμνητός.shortDefinition: to be highly hymned, extolled above all

ὑπερφρονέω.shortDefinition: to think too highly (of oneself); fig. to despise, disdain

ὑπερφωνέω.shortDefinition: to sing out loudly, shout above

ὑπευλαβέομαι.shortDefinition: to be somewhat wary of, shrink from

ὑπέχω.shortDefinition: to undergo, suffer (a penalty); lit. to hold under

ὑπηρεσία.shortDefinition: a service, assistance; fig. a household staff

ὑπνόω.shortDefinition: to slumber, fall asleep; fig. to die

ὑποβάλλω.shortDefinition: to suborn, put up (secretly); lit. to throw under

ὑποβλέπω.shortDefinition: to look askance at, eye suspiciously

ὑπογραμμός.shortDefinition: a tracing model, copy; fig. a pattern to follow

ὑπογράφω.shortDefinition: to write below, append (in writing); fig. to indicate

ὑπόγυος.shortDefinition: to be close at hand, imminent

ὑποδείκνυμι.shortDefinition: to show plainly, point out; fig. to warn, teach

ὑποδέχομαι.shortDefinition: to receive as a guest, welcome

ὑποδέω.shortDefinition: to bind on (sandals), shoe; refl. to put on sandals

ὑπόδικος.shortDefinition: to be liable to judgment, answerable (to)

ὑποδύω.shortDefinition: to slip under, go down beneath

ὑποζύγιον.shortDefinition: a beast of burden, pack animal; fig. a donkey

ὑπόθεσις.shortDefinition: a subject, theme; lit. a putting under

ὑποκαίω.shortDefinition: to burn underneath, fire up (from below)

ὑπόκειμαι.shortDefinition: to lie below, be set out below; fig. to be subject (to)

ὑποκρίνομαι.shortDefinition: to feign, pretend; lit. to play a (stage) role

ὑπόκρισις.shortDefinition: a pretense, play-acting; trad. a hypocrisy

ὑποκριτής.shortDefinition: a pretender; lit. a stage actor; trad. a hypocrite

ὑπολαμβάνω.shortDefinition: to take up, gather; fig. to suppose

ὑπολείπω.shortDefinition: to leave over, spare, reserve; refl. to be left, remain

ὑπολήνιον.shortDefinition: a vat (under a winepress), wine pit

ὑπόλυσις.shortDefinition: a slackening, giving way (as of knees)

ὑπομαστίδιος.shortDefinition: to be at the breast, suckling

ὑπομνηματισμός.shortDefinition: a record, memorandum; pl. the archives, chronicles

ὑποπίπτω.shortDefinition: to fall under; fig. to befall, fall to (one’s lot)

ὑποπλέω.shortDefinition: to sail under the lee of

ὑποπυρρίζω.shortDefinition: to be somewhat reddish, tinged with red

ὑπορράπτω.shortDefinition: to stitch up, mend; fig. to repair

ὑποσκελίζω.shortDefinition: to trip up (from under), make stumble; fig. to overthrow

ὑποστέλλω.shortDefinition: to withhold, keep back; refl. to shrink back, draw back

ὑπόστημα.shortDefinition: an outpost, garrison; fig. a station

ὑποτάσσω.shortDefinition: to subject, subdue; lit. to put under orders

ὑποτίθημι.shortDefinition: to place under, lay down; fig. to risk, suggest

ὑποτρέχω.shortDefinition: to run under (the lee of), run past

ὑποτύπωσις.shortDefinition: an outline, sketch; fig. a model, example

ὑποχείριος.shortDefinition: to be under one’s hand, in one’s power

ὑποχωρέω.shortDefinition: to withdraw quietly, retreat, go back

ὑπτιάζω.shortDefinition: to turn upward, spread out (the hands)

ὕπτιος.shortDefinition: to be smooth-flowing, level; lit. to be face-up, supine

ὑπώπιον.shortDefinition: a black eye, bruise (on the face)

ὗς.shortDefinition: a swine, hog; fig. a sow

ὑστερέω.shortDefinition: to be late, fall short; fig. to lack, be in need

ὑστέρημα.shortDefinition: a shortfall, deficiency; fig. a need, poverty

ὑφάπτω.shortDefinition: to set fire to (from below), kindle under

ὑφίστημι.shortDefinition: to hold one’s ground, withstand; fig. to endure, stay behind

ὑψαυχενέω.shortDefinition: to carry the neck high; fig. to show off, strut

ὑψηλός.shortDefinition: to be high, lofty; fig. to be exalted, haughty

ὕψιστος.shortDefinition: to be highest, most high; fig. to be the Most High (God)

ὕψος.shortDefinition: a height, elevation; fig. an exaltation

ὑψόω.shortDefinition: to lift/raise up, elevate; fig. to exalt

ὕψωμα.shortDefinition: a high thing, elevation; fig. an exaltation, arrogance
